INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.

6. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
